north_star: Test preservation and recovery of bounded observed assignment memory through explicit interruptions in independently varied synthetic developmental episode histories.
hypothesis: Full nine-slot observed placement retention can reacquire useful assignments after two deterministic full-cache resets, possibly reducing post-interruption movement compared with write-matched sham on fresh nonaliased environments.
freeze: Freeze interruptions at starts of episodes3 and6, four drift schedules and identical cache resets/sham controls before first scientific evaluation. No selection or additional retries after results.
environment: Reuse Y037 SHA256-keyed full-seed and episode seven-active/16-motif schedule, guaranteed Hall7 matching and 24 distinct full environment fingerprints per drift regime; 16 cells, four-way collision and radius2 unchanged.
arms: uninterrupted matched-sham cache writes and no reads
uninterrupted full-cache with legal preference reads
interrupted matched-sham: delete cache only at episode starts3 and6
interrupted full-cache: same reset and legal preference reads from any subsequently observed assignments
primary: Per regime/seed total churn, post-reset episodes3..7 returning-key churn, cache writes and search calls, matched key/occupancy trajectories within each uninterrupted or interrupted arm pair; per-episode legal preference counts. RECOVERY_BENEFIT if interrupted full cache saves total returning-key churn vs interrupted sham on at least 3 of 4 regimes AND at least one post-reset later episode (4,5,7) has positive heldout churn saving in each such regime; PARTIAL if total savings in at least 2 regimes but fails strict; NO_RECOVERY otherwise.
controls: Exact reset event before episode3 and6; no hidden memory except evaluator-only prior placement history for outcome accounting
Each arm's action uses only present graph and cached previous observed assignments
Matched cache writes/key trajectory between full/sham within same interruption policy
24 unique histories per regime, Hall oracle cardinality7 per episode
All orig first-use evidence archived before a full pytest regression
claim_limit: Synthetic episodic assignment reconstruction after cache clear, not semantic consolidation, developmental regeneration or biological evidence.
